# Adviuz

> Adviuz (adviuz.ca) is a Canadian advertising platform by Instad Web Services Ltd. (Saskatoon, SK, roots back to 2014). Businesses buy digital flyer campaigns priced per viewed flyer — the balance only decreases when a flyer is actually viewed — and receive leads with contact details in a dashboard. An add-on called the Conversion Engine answers leads in seconds with AI calls, texts and emails, books appointments, and keeps following up for up to six months, within strict courtesy rules (contact 9 AM-7 PM in the lead's timezone, max 2 touches/day, CASL-compliant opt-outs).
